title: No footage until the Lady allowed filming

tellings.quote: Well, let me tell you, from 2007 to 2012, I had zero data. I was out every night with a camera trying to get pictures to save myself from the community, right?

plain: From 2007 to 2012 a North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe went out behind his house every night with a camera to film the lights he says he was seeing, and he got nothing, "zero data." He tells Michels he wanted pictures "to save myself from the community," and that footage only came once a presence he calls the Lady allowed filming, which would mean whatever he saw chose when to be recorded.
